# upbit-premium-chart

> Static web page that charts the live BMT premium on Upbit (KRW converted to USDT) over Binance spot, with Binance perp alongside. No backend, no API key.

The page loads today's 1-minute candles from Upbit and Binance, converts Upbit's won price with either USD/KRW or Upbit's KRW-USDT, and keeps updating through the Upbit WebSocket and 2-second Binance polling. Premium = venue price / Binance spot - 1.

## Files

- [index.html](index.html): the whole app
- [README.md](README.md): usage, data sources and limitations
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): data flow and constraints for AI coding assistants
